mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_wo_supplement WHERE status = 'APPROVED') AS "supplementToIssue", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_work_order WHERE status IN ('RELEASED', 'STARTED') AND plan_end < #{today}) AS "woOverdue", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_inspection WHERE status = 'DRAFT') AS "qcDraft", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qms_ncr WHERE status = 'OPEN') AS "ncrOpen", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qms_capa WHERE status = 'OPEN' AND due_date < #{today}) AS "capaOverdue", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_equipment WHERE status <> 'SCRAPPED' AND next_maintain_date IS NOT NULL AND next_maintain_date <= #{today}) AS "maintainDue"
